apps.label: Rusty XR Quest Camera Composite Layer
apps.description: Public immersive Quest example with explicit synthetic, CPU diagnostic, GPU camera-buffer probe, and projected stereo camera tiers plus optional MediaProjection screen streaming.

deviceProfiles.label: XR composite smoke test

deviceProfiles.label: XR composite comparison level 4
deviceProfiles.description: Controlled Quest comparison profile for projection-performance samples that need declared CPU/GPU levels.

deviceProfiles.label: XR composite comparison level 5

runtimeProfiles.label: Synthetic layer smoke test
runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the OpenXR layer without camera or screen capture for lifecycle and renderer isolation.

runtimeProfiles.label: Meta hand mesh particles
runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the OpenXR layer without camera or environment-depth acquisition, requests XR_EXT_hand_tracking plus XR_FB_hand_tracking_mesh, prefers a stage-anchored reference space, skins the immutable runtime hand mesh from per-frame hand-joint locations, samples stable Rusty XR hand-particle coordinates through LiveHandMeshParticleSampler, keeps intra-hand and bounded cross-hand neighbor links available, and renders the particles as stereo Vulkan billboards over the native passthrough underlay.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker H.264 consumer probe
runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the OpenXR layer without its own camera acquisition, asks a running broker APK for a bounded app-camera H.264 stream over device-local localhost, and decodes the packets with Android MediaCodec into a Java-owned SurfaceTexture external texture.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker synthetic H.264 OpenXR layer probe
runtimeProfiles.description: Asks the running broker APK for a bounded deterministic MediaCodec synthetic H.264 stream, decodes it into hardware buffers, and draws it through the same OpenXR projection receiver path used by broker camera streams.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker synthetic target-footprint edge stimulus HWB
runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the target-footprint edge-band broker stimulus through the HWB path with metadata-owned placement and renderer debug colors kept distinct from stimulus colors.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker synthetic target-footprint edge stretch HWB

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Broker synthetic target-local raster profile uses stream metadata target footprints and the same HWB peripheral-stretch contract as direct Camera2.

runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the deterministic target-footprint edge stimulus through the HWB broker H.264 path with target-local-raster stream metadata and peripheral-stretch exterior replacement.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker H.264 OpenXR layer probe
runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the OpenXR layer without its own Camera2 acquisition, asks a running broker APK for bounded app-camera H.264, latches selected Camera2 projection metadata from the stream-start result when available, decodes packets through Android MediaCodec into ImageReader PRIVATE hardware buffers, feeds those buffers into the existing Vulkan hardware-buffer import path, and draws the decoded feed in the OpenXR projection layer as a GPU-buffer probe.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker H.264 stereo OpenXR projection probe

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Broker H.264 decoded stereo hardware-buffer projection diagnostic with explicit texture orientation.
values.rustyxr.leftCameraTextureTransformReason: Left decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before release.
values.rustyxr.rightCameraTextureTransformReaso: Right decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before release.

runtimeProfiles.description: Starts two bounded broker app-camera H.264 streams, decodes both with Android MediaCodec into ImageReader PRIVATE hardware buffers, pairs decoded left/right buffers by frame index, feeds the pair through the native stereo AHardwareBuffer import bridge, and attempts the existing metadata-backed OpenXR stereo projection path. Device-specific left and right camera IDs can be supplied as launch extras.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker H.264 stereo live OpenXR projection probe

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Broker live-bounded H.264 decoded stereo hardware-buffer projection diagnostic with explicit texture orientation.
values.rustyxr.leftCameraTextureTransformReason: Left live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before release.
values.rustyxr.rightCameraTextureTransformReaso: Right live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before release.

runtimeProfiles.description: Starts two live-bounded broker app-camera H.264 streams, accepts both binary stream sockets before capture, writes schema-2 packets with source timestamps as encoder output is drained, receives left/right streams concurrently, and reports source, wire, decode, and native stereo-pair cadence before attempting the OpenXR stereo projection path.

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Broker live-bounded H.264 decoded stereo hardware-buffer projection performance diagnostic with explicit texture orientation.
values.rustyxr.leftCameraTextureTransformReason: Left live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before release.
values.rustyxr.rightCameraTextureTransformReaso: Right live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before release.

runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the same live-bounded broker app-camera H.264 stereo OpenXR projection path as the default live profile, but lowers the XR render scale to 0.65 so transport, decode, pair delivery, and GPU import can be compared against the render-cost-limited 0.75 profile.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker H.264 stereo live OpenXR projection probe (fast scale 0.65)

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Broker live-bounded H.264 decoded stereo hardware-buffer projection performance diagnostic using the direct raw-projection shader path.
values.rustyxr.leftCameraTextureTransformReason: Left live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before release.
values.rustyxr.rightCameraTextureTransformReaso: Right live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before release.

runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the live-bounded broker app-camera H.264 stereo OpenXR projection path with square camera framing, frame-order live stereo pairing, render scale 0.65, and the direct raw-projection shader variant so renderer overhead can be compared before explicitly selecting the border-composite visual-effect path.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker H.264 stereo live OpenXR projection probe (fast scale 0.75)

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Broker live-bounded H.264 decoded stereo hardware-buffer projection performance diagnostic using the direct raw-projection shader path at the visual-quality render scale.
values.rustyxr.leftCameraTextureTransformReason: Left live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before release.
values.rustyxr.rightCameraTextureTransformReaso: Right live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before release.

runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the live-bounded broker app-camera H.264 stereo OpenXR projection path with square camera framing, frame-order live stereo pairing, render scale 0.75, and the direct raw-projection shader variant. Use this as the renderer-parity profile before explicitly selecting the border-composite visual-effect path.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker H.264 stereo live OpenXR projection full-feed control

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Broker H.264 hardware-buffer projection alignment profile with full camera projection scale and explicit solid-red projection exterior fill supplied by the launcher.
values.rustyxr.leftCameraTextureTransformReason: Left live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer alignment profile.
values.rustyxr.rightCameraTextureTransformReaso: Right live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer alignment profile.

runtimeProfiles.description: Alignment profile for direct comparison against GL/OES and Makepad lanes. It intentionally uses full camera projection scale and a non-fast profile name so coordinate evidence is not confused with the older 0.75 performance profiles.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker H.264 stereo live target-local stretch HWB

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Broker Camera2 H.264 target-local raster profile uses stream metadata target footprints and the same HWB peripheral-stretch contract as direct Camera2.

runtimeProfiles.description: Runs live broker Camera2 H.264 through the HWB projection path using target-local-raster stream metadata and the target-footprint peripheral-stretch effect boundary.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker H.264 stereo live world-canvas MediaProjection diagnostic

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: World-canvas diagnostic keeps live broker H.264 source transport unchanged while rasterizing the camera content on the explicit head-anchored projection surface for MediaProjection assessment.

runtimeProfiles.description: Diagnostic profile for solving projection-surface depth and aspect before further per-eye tuning. It draws the live broker Camera2 streams on an actual head-anchored world canvas at the named projection depth, keeps the projection area full and unshifted, and enables MediaProjection so the final rendered canvas can be captured as one machine-readable display stream.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker H.264 stereo live temporal screen clamp probe (fast scale 0.75)

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Broker live-bounded H.264 decoded stereo hardware-buffer projection with screen-space temporal projection clamping at render scale 0.75.
values.rustyxr.leftCameraTextureTransformReason: Left live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before temporal projection clamping.
values.rustyxr.rightCameraTextureTransformReaso: Right live-decoded broker H.264 hardware buffer is visually checked upright before temporal projection clamping.

runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the broker app-camera H.264 stereo live OpenXR projection path with the scale075 renderer and the same experimental screen-space temporal projection clamp used by the direct Camera2 profile. Use it to compare direct-camera and streamed Q2Q receiver behavior under one temporal policy.

runtimeProfiles.label: OSC UDP listener
runtimeProfiles.description: Starts a generic OSC UDP listener in the headset app, draws a headset diagnostics panel inside the camera projection envelope, and logs received packet summaries for companion-to-headset transport checks.

runtimeProfiles.label: OSC UDP listener, no overlay
runtimeProfiles.description: Starts the same generic OSC UDP listener without drawing the headset diagnostics panel so OSC ingress cost can be measured separately from canvas rendering.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera source diagnostics
runtimeProfiles.description: Enumerates public Camera2 source capabilities and writes camera-source-diagnostics.json into the verification bundle when --out is enabled.

runtimeProfiles.label: Environment depth diagnostics
runtimeProfiles.description: Starts the OpenXR environment-depth provider with the native passthrough layer active, acquires at most one depth image per XR frame, logs depth resolution, near/far, runtime capture timestamps, acquire cost, update cadence, confidence availability, and the depth texture UV transform, and renders the current stereo depth texture in headset as a per-eye D16 grayscale diagnostic.

runtimeProfiles.label: Environment depth mesh overlay
runtimeProfiles.description: Starts the same environment-depth provider as the diagnostics profile, but renders a transparent generated depth-grid surface over the submitted native passthrough underlay from the live D16 depth texture. The mesh path samples depth in the vertex shader, reconstructs stage-space points from untransformed OpenXR FOV rays, and projects them through the current render-eye pose instead of drawing a fullscreen screen overlay. The direct visualizer draws only the current acquired image; persistent history needs owned depth copies or TSDF chunks rather than reused runtime swapchain images. The overlay uses a single dominant surface grid and colors metric depth on a ramp clamped at about 3 meters so distance, discontinuities, and mesh-cell stability can be inspected in headset.

runtimeProfiles.label: Environment depth particle overlay
runtimeProfiles.description: Keeps the environment-depth provider and passthrough underlay active, but updates a renderer-owned GPU buffer of retained stage-space billboard particles from confident in-view depth samples. Particles are filtered by local depth discontinuity, persist until the ring buffer overwrites them, and use the same metric distance color ramp clamped at about 3 meters.

runtimeProfiles.label: Environment depth scene particle map
runtimeProfiles.description: Keeps the environment-depth provider and passthrough underlay active, but writes accepted depth samples into a persistent local-space particle map. Candidate samples are quantized into metric local cells, mapped through a bounded spatial hash, confidence-blended with existing particles in the same cell, preserve existing cells when a candidate sample is invalid, actively clear visible free-space cells in front of high-confidence current surfaces, compose depth poses through VIEW space into the stable app space, fade when stale, and render as small alpha-clipped opaque default-disc metric billboards for headset-motion anchoring validation.

runtimeProfiles.label: Passthrough only layer probe
runtimeProfiles.description: Submits the native passthrough composition layer without the OpenXR projection layer so headset inspection can isolate compositor passthrough visibility from projection-layer alpha.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera diagnostic CPU copy
runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the OpenXR diagnostic flat camera copy from mono headset Camera2 frames with MediaProjection disabled for renderer isolation.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera GPU buffer probe
runtimeProfiles.description: Requests Camera2 PRIVATE hardware buffers and validates GPU-buffer availability without claiming metadata-backed stereo alignment.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Quest Camera2 hardware-buffer UVs are projected with no post-projection texture flip; FlipY remains a diagnostic override for other devices or drivers

runtimeProfiles.description: Aligned stereo Vulkan baseline. Verification fails unless one projection-status line reports paired left/right GPU buffers, platform or public estimated-profile pose, activeTier=gpu-projected, alignedProjection=true, and explicit manual visual acceptance. Keep this as the public geometry/border baseline while color and performance variants are tested separately.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite, performance scale 0.65

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Performance comparison keeps the accepted projection and border path unchanged while lowering only the OpenXR swapchain render scale

runtimeProfiles.description: Performance diagnostic profile. It keeps the aligned Vulkan RGB path, CPU uploads disabled, fixed foveation off, and the same projection/border settings, but lowers only the OpenXR render scale to test fragment-load headroom.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite, fast projection scale 0.75

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Direct Camera2 hardware-buffer stereo projection using the direct raw-projection shader path at render scale 0.75.

runtimeProfiles.description: Direct in-app Camera2 stereo projection with the direct raw-projection shader at render scale 0.75. Use it to compare the direct capture/render path against the broker renderer-parity profile without changing camera geometry or stereo mapping.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite full-feed control

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Direct Camera2 hardware-buffer stereo projection alignment profile with full camera projection scale.

runtimeProfiles.description: Direct in-app Camera2 projection alignment profile. Use it for footprint and coordinate checks, not performance comparison.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite world-canvas MediaProjection diagnostic

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Direct Camera2 world-canvas diagnostic keeps live stereo buffer acquisition unchanged while rasterizing the camera content on the explicit head-anchored projection surface for MediaProjection assessment.

runtimeProfiles.description: Direct live Camera2 diagnostic for solving projection-surface depth and aspect with MediaProjection. It uses the same full-frame camera-as-content metadata as the existing full-feed control profile, but draws the content on the explicit world canvas instead of the collapsed fullscreen projection.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite world-canvas depth 1.0 MediaProjection diagnostic

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Depth-1.0 world-canvas diagnostic keeps live Camera2 acquisition unchanged while drawing the camera content on the explicit head-anchored projection surface.

runtimeProfiles.description: Depth-1.0 comparison profile for the explicit world-canvas diagnostic. Use it as the visible-canvas reference before comparing the collapsed camera-footprint profile at the same depth, FOV, aspect, and overscan.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite world-canvas native-passthrough aligned MediaProjection reference

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Native-passthrough aligned world-canvas reference keeps live stereo Camera2 acquisition unchanged while drawing the camera content on the solved head-anchored projection surface.

runtimeProfiles.description: Current public world-canvas reference for visual alignment against native passthrough. It preserves the direct stereo GPU Camera2 path and uses the controller-solved surface values projectionDepthMeters=1.434085, cameraPreviewFovYDegrees=69.763084, cameraPreviewOffsetYMeters=-0.168832, and cameraRawOverlayOverscan=1.0.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite world-canvas target-local stretch joystick

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Direct Camera2 target-local world-canvas profile applies runtime target-footprint joystick offset and scale after source metadata so peripheral stretch grows as the target footprint shrinks.

runtimeProfiles.description: Interactive direct Camera2 HWB world-canvas profile. Left stick offsets the metadata target footprint in display-eye screen UV; right stick Y scales that footprint around its center, so shrinking the target increases the peripheral-stretch exterior.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite world-canvas target-local stretch breath

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Direct Camera2 target-local world-canvas profile maps broker bio:breath volume01 to runtime target-footprint scale after source metadata so peripheral stretch grows and shrinks without controller input.

runtimeProfiles.description: Interactive direct Camera2 HWB world-canvas profile. The broker-derived bio:breath volume01 stream drives projectionTargetScale with controller tuning disabled; higher volume maps to a larger target footprint unless projectionTargetBreathInvert is enabled.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite custom target-local stretch joystick

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Direct Camera2 target-local display-screen-homography profile uses the same metadata target-footprint stretch contract as world-canvas while keeping projection geometry stable.

runtimeProfiles.description: Interactive direct Camera2 HWB display-screen-homography profile. It keeps target-local-raster source placement and the same target-footprint peripheral-stretch contract as the world-canvas joystick profile, so custom and canvas can be compared without retuning projection geometry.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite camera-footprint native-aligned canvas equivalent (historical depth1 id)

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Collapsed camera-footprint comparison uses the native-passthrough aligned world-canvas projection depth, preview FOV, vertical offset, source aspect, and overscan, but reconstructs the bounded content surface through display-screen homography.

runtimeProfiles.description: Custom projection comparison profile for the camera-footprint contract. The profile id is preserved for compatibility with older depth-1 capture scripts, but the values now match the native-passthrough aligned world-canvas reference. It should match the native-aligned world-canvas MediaProjection and HzDB geometry when the fullscreen collapsed path is equivalent to the explicit canvas; passthrough remains visible outside the valid camera footprint through source alpha, not by stretching the camera feed.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo temporal pose clamp, fast projection scale 0.75

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Direct Camera2 hardware-buffer stereo projection with pose-delta temporal projection clamping at render scale 0.75.

runtimeProfiles.description: Direct in-app Camera2 stereo projection with the direct raw-projection shader and an experimental pose-delta temporal projection clamp. Use it to prove lockstep left/right smoothing and residual metrics before the screen-motion clamp is tuned visually.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo temporal screen clamp, fast projection scale 0.75

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Direct Camera2 hardware-buffer stereo projection with screen-space temporal projection clamping at render scale 0.75.

runtimeProfiles.description: Direct in-app Camera2 stereo projection with the direct raw-projection shader and an experimental screen-space temporal projection clamp. Use it against the scale075 baseline to measure projection residual, visual lag, and visible stability before carrying the policy into streamed Q2Q profiles.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo projection-area diagnostic, fast projection scale 0.75

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Projection-area diagnostic keeps the validated scale075 camera geometry but renders a synthetic footprint target instead of live camera pixels.

runtimeProfiles.description: Synthetic projection-footprint witness for the validated direct Camera2 stereo geometry. It keeps the same scale075 camera acquisition, stereo mapping, overscan, and render scale as the live target, but the shader draws a high-contrast diagnostic inside the valid projected camera footprint and a cyan border around that footprint.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite, fast projection scale 0.65

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Direct Camera2 hardware-buffer stereo projection using the direct raw-projection shader path at render scale 0.65.

runtimeProfiles.description: Direct in-app Camera2 stereo projection with the direct raw-projection shader at render scale 0.65 for fragment-load headroom checks.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite, no AE FPS target

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Acquisition comparison keeps projection, border, sampler, color mode, and render scale fixed while sending no explicit Camera2 AE FPS target

runtimeProfiles.description: Acquisition diagnostic profile. It keeps the aligned Vulkan external-RGB path, render scale 0.65, CPU uploads disabled, fixed foveation off, and the same projection/border settings, but sends no explicit Camera2 AE FPS target.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite, ImageReader max 3

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Acquisition comparison keeps projection, border, sampler, color mode, render scale, and AE target fixed while reducing the separate-eye ImageReader max image count

runtimeProfiles.description: Acquisition diagnostic profile. It keeps the aligned Vulkan external-RGB path, render scale 0.65, CPU uploads disabled, fixed foveation off, and the same projection/border settings, but reduces each separate-eye Camera2 ImageReader max image count to 3.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite, native NDK acquisition

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Native acquisition comparison keeps projection, border, sampler, color mode, and render scale fixed while using Android NDK ACamera/AImageReader hardware-buffer readers

runtimeProfiles.description: Experimental acquisition diagnostic profile. It keeps the same Vulkan projection, border, external-RGB sampler, CPU-upload-disabled path, and render scale 0.65, but swaps Java Camera2 acquisition for an Android NDK ACamera/AImageReader PRIVATE hardware-buffer reader with no explicit AE FPS target and reader max images 3. It is not release-ready unless camera-frame progression keeps moving.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite, native single-camera mirror

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Single-camera mirror acquisition comparison keeps projection and border fixed while opening one native ACamera source and mirroring its hardware buffer into both display eyes; it isolates renderer/import progression and is not stereo-alignment proof

runtimeProfiles.description: Renderer/import isolation profile. It uses the native ACamera/AImageReader hardware-buffer reader, opens one back-facing camera source, mirrors the same acquired hardware buffer into both display eyes, keeps CPU uploads disabled, and uses identity color controls. Use it to distinguish camera-source cadence from Vulkan import and OpenXR rendering; it is not a stereo alignment or color-parity release candidate.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite, shader YCbCr diagnostic

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Shader-side YCbCr comparison keeps the accepted projection and border path unchanged while testing whether the imported sampler exposes channel-packed camera values

runtimeProfiles.description: Color diagnostic profile. It keeps the same aligned stereo Vulkan path but decodes sampled channels as Cr/Y/Cb BT.601 narrow range in the shader. Use it only when hardware-buffer diagnostics show the sampler is not already presenting RGB.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite, fixed foveation experiment

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Fixed-foveation comparison keeps the accepted projection, border, sampler, and color controls unchanged while enabling the OpenXR fragment-density-map path

runtimeProfiles.description: Performance diagnostic profile for OpenXR fixed foveation. It is not release-ready unless logs show fixedFoveationEnabled=true, non-null fragment-density images, no framebuffer or driver failure, stable OpenXR cadence, and no stale camera frames.

runtimeProfiles.label: Camera stereo GPU composite, quad-surface mode

values.rustyxr.cameraTextureTransformReason: Quad-surface projection comparison keeps Camera2 hardware-buffer UVs unflipped after projection; FlipY remains a diagnostic override for other devices or drivers

runtimeProfiles.description: A/B projection profile. It keeps the same paired Camera2 GPU-buffer path and public border, reconstructs the content-surface UV that a head-anchored quad would rasterize, and leaves the visual release gate closed while operator testing compares projection geometry and color behavior against the default display-screen homography. This profile is not yet the final performance or color reference.

runtimeProfiles.label: Passthrough underlay hotload, neutral
runtimeProfiles.description: Launches a transparent OpenXR projection layer over the native compositor passthrough underlay. This profile is intended for live style hotload through a second intent, not camera acquisition.

runtimeProfiles.label: Passthrough underlay hotload, BCS
runtimeProfiles.description: Live native compositor passthrough profile using brightness/contrast/saturation plus public edge rendering values.

runtimeProfiles.label: Passthrough underlay hotload, gradient
runtimeProfiles.description: Live native compositor passthrough profile using a generic 256-entry luminance-to-RGBA gradient map.

runtimeProfiles.label: Passthrough underlay hotload, RGB LUT opponent
runtimeProfiles.description: Live native compositor passthrough profile using XR_META_passthrough_color_lut with a smooth RGB opponent palette.

runtimeProfiles.label: Passthrough underlay hotload, RGB LUT flicker 10 Hz
runtimeProfiles.description: WARNING: intentional strobing profile. Device-side square-wave switch between an RGB LUT and its half-phase inverse at 10 full cycles per second, with a 120 Hz display-refresh request.

runtimeProfiles.label: Passthrough underlay hotload, RGB LUT flicker 40 Hz
runtimeProfiles.description: WARNING: intentional strobing profile. Device-side square-wave switch between an RGB LUT and its half-phase inverse at 40 full cycles per second. At 120 Hz this is frame-quantized because each half-cycle averages 1.5 display frames.

runtimeProfiles.label: Passthrough underlay hotload, RGB LUT flicker 60 Hz
runtimeProfiles.description: WARNING: intentional strobing profile. Device-side square-wave switch between an RGB LUT and its half-phase inverse at 60 full cycles per second. This requires 120 state transitions per second, so it aliases unless the runtime presents at 120 Hz and accepts per-frame style updates.

runtimeProfiles.label: Full-field red/black flicker 10 Hz
runtimeProfiles.description: WARNING: intentional full-field strobing profile. OpenXR projection-layer clear-color flicker between bright red and black at 10 full cycles per second with a 120 Hz display-refresh request.

runtimeProfiles.label: Full-field red/black flicker 40 Hz
runtimeProfiles.description: WARNING: intentional full-field strobing profile. OpenXR projection-layer clear-color flicker between bright red and black at 40 full cycles per second with a 120 Hz display-refresh request; half-cycles are frame-quantized.

runtimeProfiles.label: Full-field red/black flicker 60 Hz
runtimeProfiles.description: WARNING: intentional full-field strobing profile. OpenXR projection-layer clear-color flicker between bright red and black at 60 full cycles per second; this requires 120 rendered frames per second and one state change per displayed frame.

runtimeProfiles.label: MediaProjection stream
runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the diagnostic flat camera copy and requests MediaProjection consent only to stream the final screen to a Windows receiver over adb reverse.
